entities.summary: Free Thai Movement, a transformative movement in Thailand (1944–1957). Emerged from Country renamed from Siam to Thailand ('Land of the Free') and 1932 Revolution and Phibun Era. Catalyzed Ananda Mahidol and King Ananda Mahidol (Rama VIII) found shot dead in mysterious circumstances.
